Event from 11 to 15 November (prizes until 30 November); 2–6 hours to light all the basins

Every year in November, {npc:Lucius} asks Lightbearers to keep 10 {item:Lightbringer's Basin|sacred basins} scattered around the world lit for 96 hours. You receive a {item:Magical Torch} in Yalahar and use it on each basin, facing the creatures of darkness that may appear. If the server succeeds, there are global bonuses and a rewards room in Kazordoon with backpacks full of rings, gems, Midnight Shards and achievements.

At that special time of year when the veil between worlds is thin and the darkness tries to break through, Lucius calls on Lightbearers to keep the sacred light basins burning for four days. Do not let a single one go out, or all hope will be lost.
Only during the event (11 to 15 November). The rewards stay available for another 15 days, until 30 November.
No minimum level (20+ recommended). Some basins have very strong creatures.
Partial Premium: the {item:Magical Torch} can be lent, so Free players can take part if someone passes them the torch (for example at the Dwacatra basin, accessible to Free).
Forbidden Lands basin: access to the Forbidden Lands of Tiquanda (Mission 8 of the {wiki:The Ape City Quest}).
Ramoa basin: {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest} done (or do it until you reach Ramoa).

Each player can only light each basin **once per year**. The basins can be lit in any order.

Each basin has a 180-minute timer. Using the torch resets the time to 180/180, so you can light any basin without ruining the schedule of whoever is organising the server. Coordinate with the other players on your world.
You do not need to kill the creatures that appear for the basin to count as lit.
Useful tools: TibiaWiki's {wiki:TibiaWiki:Tools/Lightbearer Basin Monitor|Lightbearer Basin Monitor} tracks the time of each basin.
If you are only going to light one basin, avoid the Magician Quarter one (near Lucius): it is the hardest to guard and the organisers appreciate you choosing another.
Reach Yalahar and the Magician Quarter

{npc:Lucius} is in {wiki:Yalahar}. {npc:Captain Max} takes you there from **Liberty Bay** ({key:hi}, {key:yalahar}, {key:yes}; 400 gp, you need to have started the {wiki:In Service of Yalahar Quest}); if you already have the routes from that quest, there is a direct boat from Ab'Dendriel, Ankrahmun, Carlin, Darashia, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Thais and Venore. From the port, pass from district to district via the gate guards, saying {key:pass} and the destination to each one: {npc:Peter} (Trade → Factory Quarter), {npc:Oliver} (Factory → Sunken Quarter) and {npc:Barry} (Sunken → Magician Quarter). If you have already unlocked the gate mechanisms, you can use them.
Go to the Yalahar **Magician Quarter**, in the north-east area, and talk to {npc:Lucius}: say {key:hi} and {key:yes}. He takes you to the {wiki:Temple of Light}.
In the Temple of Light, go up the stairs and look for Lucius again. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. You receive the {item:Magical Torch}.

The {wiki:Temple of Light} is on an island **north-west** of Rookgaard and can only be reached with Lucius. The sources do not describe the return in detail: after you receive the torch, talk to {npc:Lucius} again in the temple or look for the way off the island to return to the mainland and start lighting the basins.

Use the {item:Magical Torch} on a {item:Lightbringer's Basin} to light it. After using it, there is a chance that creatures will appear for 5 minutes, in groups of 1 to 5, getting stronger until the 3rd or 4th wave and then weaker. Look at the orange message: *"... keeps the basin burning for another three hours."* means there is no raid; if it ends with *"... but creatures of darkness are coming to take over the light!"*, get ready to fight.
At the Forbidden Lands and Magician Quarter basins the creatures are especially strong: even high-level players should bring a second player.
Each basin has a unique event creature (very rare in the Bestiary: it only needs 5 kills).

Leave **Svargrond** to the north and walk west. Follow the outside of the mountain (avoid the Frost Trolls of Svargrond) until you find a spot where you can use {spell:Levitate} up three times. Levitate to the top and go around the mountain clockwise to the south side. Levitate up again and follow the path west to the basin. **How to get there:** take the boat to **Svargrond** in Carlin, Thais or Venore ({key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}); you arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, on the **east** side of the city. **How to leave:** go back the same way and use {spell:Levitate} to go down at every place where you went up; in Svargrond, Captain Breezelda takes you back ({key:carlin}, {key:thais} or {key:venore}).
Path to the Formorgar Glacier basin

Go to the **Plains of Havoc** and head straight south. The basin is near the {wiki:Knightwatch Tower}, south of the mountain where the {wiki:Holy Tible} is. **How to get there:** the Plains of Havoc are **south-west of Venore**: leave the city and walk south-west. **How to leave:** walk back the same way to Venore.

You need access to the Forbidden Lands (Mission 8 of the {wiki:The Ape City Quest}). Cross Tiquanda east to the foot of the mountain where {npc:The Blind Prophet} is. Say {key:hi} and {key:transport} to him to be taken to the Forbidden Lands. Once inside, follow the coast north-east to the basin, a little north-east of the Behemoths cave. **How to get there:** take the boat to **Port Hope** ({key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}) and cross the Tiquanda jungle to the **east**, beyond Banuta. **How to leave:** go back the same way to where the Blind Prophet dropped you off (near the ramp and the Behemoths cave) and return to Port Hope through the jungle.

This basin tends to get **overcrowded** with creatures. Stay next to the basin and kill the creatures until they stop appearing (about 5 minutes). There is a small spot north of the basin where only one creature can attack you in melee. Do not pull monsters onto the ramp: it makes it harder for others to help.

Bring the {item:Key 3802}. Go to the main gate of **Kazordoon** (you can take the wagons to "Main Gate"). Go down the stairs that are far to the east of the wagons and keep going down until you reach {wiki:Dwacatra}. The basin is at the far north of the prison, directly north of the entrance. Bring a {item:Shovel} and {item:Rope}: Dwacatra has small holes that open with the shovel. To get to Kazordoon use the {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine ({key:kazordoon}) or walk in through the mountain. **How to leave:** go up with the {item:Rope} through the holes and the stairs you came down to Kazordoon's main gate.

It is the easiest basin and is accessible to Free accounts. Sometimes players lock the Dwacatra door to block access. Creatures: {creature:Dwarf}, {creature:Dwarf Soldier}, {creature:Dwarf Guard}, {creature:Orc Shaman}, {creature:Orc Berserker}, {creature:Minotaur}, {creature:Minotaur Archer}, {creature:Minotaur Mage} and {creature:Bride of Night}.

If you have already done {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest}, go to {wiki:Ramoa} through the {wiki:Goroma} teleport, walk west to the sea and follow the coast south to the basin. If you have not done it, you have to complete that quest up to reaching Ramoa; on the surface, go west to the basin. Then you can return to Goroma through the teleport. **How to get to Goroma:** at the **Liberty Bay** port talk to {npc:Jack Fate}: {key:hi}, {key:goroma}, {key:yes} (500 gp). In Goroma, go down the stairs of the Teleportation Hub and step into the teleport that leads to Ramoa. **How to leave:** in Ramoa, go down the hub stairs and step into the **left** teleport to return to Goroma; go up, head **east** to Jack Fate's ship and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} to return to Liberty Bay.
Before you go, check on the {wiki:World Board} whether the mini world change {wiki:Fire from the Earth} is active in Goroma. If it is, wait or bring a team.

Creatures (not counting the way through Goroma's volcano): {creature:Crypt Shambler}, {creature:Bonebeast}, {creature:Demon Skeleton}, {creature:Giant Spider}, {creature:Water Elemental} and {creature:Shadow Hound}.

Go to the {wiki:Hero Cave} and follow the path as if you were going to do the {wiki:Annihilator Quest}. At the last bend, instead of going south, keep going **east**. You see a pit with a {creature:Demon} in it. The basin is on the north side; you do not need to enter the pit. **How to get there:** take the boat to **Edron** ({key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}); from the port go **north** to the Hero Cave entrance. **How to leave:** go back the same way, going up with the {item:Rope} at the holes where you went down, to the entrance; then {npc:Captain Seahorse}, at the Edron port, takes you to other cities.

The teleport takes you into the Demon's pit.

The basin is in {wiki:Drefia}, near the level 60 {wiki:Gate of Expertise} that leads to the {wiki:Medusa Shield Quest} and the {wiki:Drefia Wyrm Lair}. **How to get there:** go to **Darashia** (boat: {key:darashia}) and cross the mountains to the **west** to Drefia (for example, climb the mountain with the {item:Rope} at {coord:33048,32429,7}); enter the main dungeon and go down to the level 60 gate. **How to leave:** go back the same way, going up the dungeon floors to the entrance, and cross the mountain back to Darashia.
Rope spot to climb up to Drefia

Go to the bottom of {wiki:Hellgate} (see {wiki:Route:Hellgate|the Hellgate route} for the path). The basin is on the marked floor. **How to get there:** in **Ab'Dendriel**, go down three times (shop area, next to the little houses and again), head **south** and **east** to the *Hellgate* door and open it with the {item:Key 3012} ({npc:Elathriel} sells it for 5000 gp). Pass the second door to the **north** and step into the portal (not the one on the west side, which leads out).
The Hellgate portal is one-way: bring a {item:Rope} and {spell:Levitate} (or 6 {item:Parcel|Parcels}), otherwise you cannot get out.

Go back to the exit route and follow the {wiki:Route:Hellgate|Route:Hellgate}: long corridor to the rope spot (go up with the {item:Rope}); **south-east** through the Rotworm cave, go down, a little **south** and go up; **south** and go up again; **south** and go down the **first** hole; cross the big Ghoul room to the **west**, next to the south wall, and go down; head **north-west** and go up **2 floors** with {spell:Levitate} (or 6 Parcels) and the stairs; head **south-west** and go up the hole; pull the bridge lever if needed and follow the only way up. You come out on the surface near Ab'Dendriel.
Hellgate exit: go up with the rope
Hellgate exit: go up 2 floors with Levitate or Parcels
Hellgate exit: the bridge lever and the path to the surface

Enter the {wiki:Tarpit Tomb}. The basin is on the first hunting floor, north-west of the entrance. **How to get there:** the Tarpit Tomb is beneath the Kha'labal desert, near **Ankrahmun** (boat: {key:ankrahmun}); at the entrance, dig with the {item:Shovel} to open the hole. **How to leave:** go back the same way and go up the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
Tarpit Tomb entrance (dig with the Shovel)

Go to the {creature:Hellspawn|Hellspawns} area in the Yalahar **Magician Quarter**. Go down the **east ramp** and look west: if there are many {creature:Duskbringer|Duskbringers}, fight your way through the cave to the other side. If there are not, go back up the ramp and go down the west ramp. The basin is just north-west of the west ramp. **How to leave:** go back up the same ramp to the Magician Quarter surface, near Lucius.

It is the hardest basin to guard: there is a lot of luring and overspawn. **Never** try to clear a spawn full of Duskbringers from the west ramp; it is much safer to cross the cave. If you have to go through the cave, use {item:Energy Wall Rune|Energy Wall Runes} to split the Duskbringers into smaller groups.

If any basin goes out, there are raids of {creature:Essence of Darkness|Essences of Darkness} in all cities and the message *"Strong demonic creatures have passed the border to our world and invade the Temple of Light! Run, as long as you still can - or fight them, if you dare!"* appears. The evil side of the Temple of Light is invaded by {creature:Eclipse Knight|Eclipse Knights}, {creature:Gloombringer|Gloombringers}, {creature:Harbringer of Darkness|Harbringers of Darkness} and {creature:Spawn of Despair}, but you cannot fight them.
Even if the world fails, the achievements you earned stay.

If the basins stay lit for the full 96 hours, there are raids of {creature:Spirit of Light|Spirits of Light} in all cities and every player gets +10% experience in a party with shared experience and +3% {wiki:Life Leech} / +1% {wiki:Mana Leech} until 30 November. Whoever lit basins can go and collect the rewards.
Buy a {item:Wagon Ticket} (250 gp) from one of the ticket sellers of the ore wagon system.

Take any wagon to Kazordoon's **Main Gate** and walk south-west to the reward room. To get to Kazordoon use the {wiki:Steamship} from Cormaya or Farmine ({key:kazordoon}) or the magic carpet. To leave, go back to the Main Gate and take a wagon again.

Use the {wiki:Statue of Fafnar (Lightbearer)|Statue of Fafnar}: you receive the {item:Silver Fafnar Trophy} (at least 1 basin) or the {item:Golden Fafnar Trophy} (all 10 basins) and the achievements **Keeper of the Flame** and **I Did My Part**.
Pick up the room's rewards according to the number of basins you lit. Make sure you have enough free capacity.

{item:Silver Fafnar Trophy}, 20 {item:Midnight Shard|Midnight Shards}, {item:Brocade Backpack} with {item:Death Ring}, {item:Ring of Healing}, {item:Stealth Ring}, {item:Time Ring}, 50 {item:Christmas Token|Christmas Tokens}, 2 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots}, {item:Giant Shimmering Pearl (Green)} and 30 {item:Small Topaz}. Capacity: 132.80 oz

Everything above (with the {item:Golden Fafnar Trophy} instead of the Silver) + achievement **True Lightbearer** + {item:Brocade Backpack} with 10 {item:Midnight Shard|Midnight Shards} and, rarely, a {item:Celestial Torch} + {item:Crown Backpack} with {item:Might Ring}, 2 {item:Ring of Healing|Rings of Healing}, 50 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}, 4 {item:Gold Ingot|Gold Ingots}, {item:Violet Gem} and 40 {item:Small Diamond|Small Diamonds}
Total capacity for all 10 basins: 326.70 oz without Celestial Torch or Moon Backpack; 344.70 oz with Celestial Torch; 346.70 oz with Moon Backpack and Document; 364.70 oz with everything.

Each basin has a creature that only exists during the event. They are *very rare* in the Bestiary (5 kills to unlock), great for earning Charm Points. Using the torch does not guarantee a raid: each activation has a random chance.
If you want Charm Points, light the basins and kill these creatures when they appear.
The event consists of keeping all 10 {item:Lightbringer's Basin|basins} lit for 96 hours in a row.
{item:Magical Torch|Torches} are not bound to a player: you can lend yours to another player.
The {item:Magical Torch} disappears at the end of November.
